zkwars-workers.builder.no_selection: No schematic is selected in Litematica
zkwars-workers.builder.too_far: The schematic is more than 128 blocks from the bench
zkwars-workers.builder.too_big: The schematic has more than 200000 blocks
zkwars-workers.builder.empty: The schematic has no placeable blocks
zkwars-workers.builder.api: Could not read the Litematica schematic
gui.zkwars-workers.radius.lumber: Horizontal radius from 1 to 32, 16 by default. The area reaches from -4 to +48 so tall trees fit. Shears in the offhand also cut leaves.
gui.zkwars-workers.pen.limit.tooltip: How many adults to keep, from 2 to 32. Extras are culled if there is a sword.
item.zkwars-workers.worker_scroll.empty: Empty scroll. Click a work block, then a bed.
item.zkwars-workers.worker_scroll.smelte: This block needs a smelter order scroll
item.zkwars-workers.smelter_scroll.empty: Empty scroll. Click the smelter, then Shift-right-click furnaces, then a bed.
item.zkwars-workers.smelter_scroll.furna: This furnace is not on the scroll
item.zkwars-workers.courier_scroll.empty: Empty scroll. Click a chest, then work blocks, then a bed.
item.zkwars-workers.courier_supply_scrol: Empty scroll. Click a chest, then work blocks, then a bed.
Empty scroll. Click a chest, barrel, or shulker, then up to 32 containers, then a bed.
advancements.zkwars-workers.root.title: Workers
advancements.zkwars-workers.root.descrip: People work at job blocks and sleep in a bed at night. Couriers carry items between those blocks and a chest.
Right-click it to open supplies and output. The work area stays outlined while that screen is open.
advancements.zkwars-workers.scroll.title: Assignment scroll
advancements.zkwars-workers.scroll.descr: Click a work block, then a bed. The smelter does not take this scroll.
advancements.zkwars-workers.work_block.d: Now click a bed. Without one, the worker does not know where to sleep.
advancements.zkwars-workers.bed.title: Bed
advancements.zkwars-workers.bed.descript: Take a worker of the same job and click them with the scroll.
advancements.zkwars-workers.assigned.des: By day they walk to the block, at night to the bed. An empty hand opens the inspection. Shift and an empty hand take the scroll back. The wrong job will not accept it.
advancements.zkwars-workers.inspect.desc: The order, status, tool, and cargo are here. Courier and smelter cargo can be fixed in this screen.
advancements.zkwars-workers.tool.title: Intact tool
advancements.zkwars-workers.tool.descrip: Pickaxe for the quarry, hoe for the farm, axe for the trees, sword for the pens, fishing rod for the fisher, hammer for the builder. Spares go in the block: a broken tool is replaced from there. The smelter and the crafter need no tool.
advancements.zkwars-workers.working.desc: They are at the block and the tool is intact. Any other status says what is missing.
advancements.zkwars-workers.sleeping.des: After sunset the work stops. Two workers cannot share one bed: the other gets the status "Bed occupied".
advancements.zkwars-workers.output.title: Take the output
advancements.zkwars-workers.output.descr: Work stops while the output is full. A courier can carry it from here.
advancements.zkwars-workers.courier_scro: Click a chest, then up to five work blocks, then a bed. The courier takes finished goods from the output.
advancements.zkwars-workers.courier_rout: They carry up to four stacks at a time.
advancements.zkwars-workers.courier_deli: If the chest is full, the cargo gets stuck and may go back into the block.
advancements.zkwars-workers.supply_scrol: The same clicks, the other way: from the chest into the blocks.
advancements.zkwars-workers.supply_run.d: Seeds and bone meal for the farm, feed for the pens, ore and fuel for the smelter, pattern items for the crafter, intact tools for the rest. Broken tools are not carried. The last stack of an item that is not stored again in the chest is left behind.
advancements.zkwars-workers.courier_five: That is the limit of one scroll.
advancements.zkwars-workers.clear_scroll: A scroll alone in the crafting grid wipes its writing. The block, bed, and route have to be set again.
advancements.zkwars-workers.quarry.title: Quarry
advancements.zkwars-workers.quarry.descr: It digs from the top down. The bounds stay visible while the block is open.
advancements.zkwars-workers.quarry_bound: No wider than 16 blocks across, and no taller than 64. It starts as a 3 by 3 square going 64 down.
advancements.zkwars-workers.quarry_mined: An intact pickaxe is required. Bedrock, and blocks beside water or lava, are skipped.
advancements.zkwars-workers.quarry_botto: Move the bounds and press Apply again.
advancements.zkwars-workers.farm.title: Farm
advancements.zkwars-workers.farm.descrip: The radius is always 8 and cannot be changed. The first three slots are seeds and bone meal.
advancements.zkwars-workers.farm_till.de: A hoe is required. Spare hoes in the block are used up too.
advancements.zkwars-workers.farm_harvest: Ripe crops are replanted immediately. No seeds means the status "No seeds".
advancements.zkwars-workers.idle.title: Unattended
advancements.zkwars-workers.idle.descrip: Only the farm and the pens keep a simple cycle while the worker is away. The quarry, trees, fishing, smelter, building, and the crafter's bench stop.
advancements.zkwars-workers.lumber.title: Lumberyard
advancements.zkwars-workers.lumber.descr: Radius from 1 to 32, 16 at first. The area runs from -4 to +48 so tall trees fit.
An axe is required. One tree is up to 256 logs.
advancements.zkwars-workers.lumber_plant: Saplings, fungi, and propagules go in the lumberyard. Ones that fall in the area are picked up.
advancements.zkwars-workers.lumber_shear: They go in the offhand, with a separate click. The axe stays in the main hand and cuts the trunk.
advancements.zkwars-workers.pen.title: Pen
advancements.zkwars-workers.pen.descript: Radius from 1 to 16. That animal's feed goes in the block. A sword is needed once adults exceed the limit: 2 to 32, 8 at first.
advancements.zkwars-workers.pen_breed.de: A pair takes one piece of feed. No feed means the status "No food".
The chicken keeper puts feathers in the block output.
The cow keeper puts leather in the block output.
advancements.zkwars-workers.pen_wool.des: The sheep keeper puts wool in the block output.
advancements.zkwars-workers.pen_pork.des: The pig keeper puts porkchops in the block output.
advancements.zkwars-workers.pen_shear.de: Shears are not needed: the sheep keeper shears on their own and spends feed to do it.
advancements.zkwars-workers.pen_cull.des: Above the adult limit, one is culled if there is a sword. The drops go into the output.
advancements.zkwars-workers.fisher.title: Fishing station
advancements.zkwars-workers.fisher.descr: A water source must be inside the radius of 1 to 16. The tool is a fishing rod.
advancements.zkwars-workers.fisher_catch: Without water in the area there is nothing to catch.
advancements.zkwars-workers.smelter.desc: It does not smelt by itself. It is three stores: input, fuel, and results. A normal worker scroll will not take this block.
advancements.zkwars-workers.smelter_scro: Click the smelter, Shift-right-click furnaces, then a bed. Ten furnaces at most.
advancements.zkwars-workers.smelter_furn: Shift-right-click again removes a furnace. A normal click does not add one.
advancements.zkwars-workers.smelt_return: The smelter carries two stacks: they take the result out and put input and fuel in.
One order can name ten furnaces.
advancements.zkwars-workers.builder.desc: Litematica is required. Blocks for the build go in the bench, and the tool is the hammer.
advancements.zkwars-workers.builder_hamm: The hammer wears down. A spare can go in the bench.
advancements.zkwars-workers.builder_sche: The Litematica selection must be within 128 blocks of the bench and no larger than 200000 blocks. Use Take schematic.
advancements.zkwars-workers.builder_plac: No schematic means the status "No schematic". No blocks in the bench means "No materials".
advancements.zkwars-workers.builder_done: The accepted schematic has no blocks left to place.
advancements.zkwars-workers.yard.title: Yard
advancements.zkwars-workers.yard.descrip: The farm and the pen are linked by supply from a chest.
advancements.zkwars-workers.works.title: Workshop
advancements.zkwars-workers.works.descri: Ore went to the furnace, and the result went to a chest.
advancements.zkwars-workers.all_people.d: Assign all twelve: the eleven jobs and a courier.
advancements.zkwars-workers.crafter.desc: The 3 by 3 grid is a pattern and is not used up. There are 18 resource slots and 9 output slots. No tool is needed.
advancements.zkwars-workers.crafter_craf: The crafter takes ingredients from the store to match the pattern and puts the result in the output. A supply courier brings only pattern items. An export courier takes everything from the output.
Click a source — a chest, barrel, or shulker box — then up to 32 containers, then a bed.
advancements.zkwars-workers.sort_route.d: A container that already holds the same item comes first, otherwise an empty one. A mixed container is skipped. What does not fit goes back to the source.
advancements.zkwars-workers.sort_deliver: The item went into its container. If there is no room, the courier carries it back to the source.
advancements.zkwars-workers.sort_full.de: That is the limit of one sort scroll.
